architecture: Buddy -> 65 MasterBots -> sub-bots -> capabilities/tools/resources -> sandbox -> benchmarks -> gap closure

placement_rules.primary_owner: Every bot has exactly one primary MasterBot owner.
placement_rules.secondary_collaborators: Cross-domain capabilities use collaborator links rather than duplicate ownership.
placement_rules.preserve_source: Grok AGI, Bots App, Real Estate and repository-specific bots remain traceable.
placement_rules.mastery_truth: A capability is mastered only after repeatable benchmark evidence is recorded.
placement_rules.runtime: Use GitHub Actions efficiently with matrix parallelism, sharding, caching, artifact reuse and priority queues; never evade platform limits.

lifecycle: FOUNDATIONS: domain vocabulary, fundamentals, safety and prerequisites
KNOWLEDGE: approved documentation, source provenance and rights-aware research
CURRICULUM: progressive lessons, worked examples and original exercises
PRACTICUM: hands-on projects, labs, simulations and real division workflows
ASSESSMENT: deterministic unit tests, rubric-based reviews and independent holdouts
REMEDIATION: diagnose errors, explain gaps, assign targeted lessons and retest
MASTERY: evidence-backed skill levels; never award mastery from lesson completion alone
CONTINUOUS_LEARNING: versioned research, change detection, regression checks and human review
learning_contract.mastery_rule: Mastery requires repeatable passing evidence on division-specific tests and independent holdouts; course completion alone is insufficient.
learning_contract.source_policy: Use shared DreamCo Institute foundations plus division-specific approved resources. Unknown rights block ingestion and training.

sub_bot_policy.rule: Every discovered bot is inventoried, assigned one primary owner, linked to secondary collaborators, benchmarked where applicable, and retained as source lineage even when consolidated.

dashboard_contract.truth: Buttons must invoke real workflows or report unavailable wiring; never decorative execution claims.

learning_division_policy.distinction: The ten resource-library categories are shared foundational resource collections, not the DreamCo division structure. Each of the 65 canonical MasterBots owns its own learning program.
learning_division_policy.shared_foundations: All divisions may use the 100-resource library as a common reference pool, selecting only relevant entries after rights and suitability review.
learning_division_policy.specialization: Each division must add domain-specific approved resources, original lessons, tasks, safety controls, benchmarks and holdout tests.
learning_division_policy.buddy_responsibility: Buddy coordinates learning across divisions, routes cross-domain lessons and shares approved patterns without erasing each division's ownership or mastery evidence.
